name: Donegal
description: Herringbone tweed: twill lines slanting one way down one column and back the other way down the next, flecked with bright knops of color.

code.style: --rule: ( --m: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2))); --r: @match(x % 2 == 0, 45deg, -45deg); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -20.71%; top: -20.71%; width: 141.42%; height: 141.42%; background-color: @p(@var(--m)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 100%, 0 50%); clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 100%, 0 50%); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 6.25%, transparent 6.25% 12.5%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 6.25%, transparent 6.25% 12.5%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--r)); transform: rotate(@var(--r)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(4% 4% at @r(8, 92)% @r(8, 92)%, #000 96%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(3% 3% at @r(8, 92)% @r(8, 92)%, #000 96%, transparent 100%); mask: radial-gradient(4% 4% at @r(8, 92)% @r(8, 92)%, #000 96%, transparent 100%), radial-gradient(3% 3% at @r(8, 92)% @r(8, 92)%, #000 96%, transparent 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
